home.title: Welcome to Postloom
home.intro: Send beautiful, personal emails to a list of people - from your own email account, with checks before anything is sent.
home.stepConnectHint: Postloom sends from your own email address, so replies come straight back to you.
home.stepConnectFix: {{name}} needs you. Open Senders & accounts to fix it.
home.stepTemplateHint: Pick a starting point and change the words to your own. Most people take about 5 minutes.
home.stepSendHint: We'll walk you through it, and check everything with you first.
home.tipNothingSent: Nothing is ever sent until you say so, and you can always send a test to yourself first.
home.tipLocal: Your lists and emails stay on this computer.

placeholder.body: This part of Postloom is being built. It will be ready in a later version.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Reusable emails you can send again and again.
templates.nameMissing: Give your template a name first.
templates.emptyBody: A template is an email you can reuse. Make one and Postloom fills in each person's details for you.
templates.subject: Subject
templates.usesFields: Details it uses from your list

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.validationFailed: Some information is missing or not valid.
errors.templateInvalid: This template couldn't be read. Check it for typing mistakes.
errors.emailAuthFailed: Your email provider didn't accept the password. Many providers, like Gmail, need an "app password" for apps like Postloom.
errors.passwordMissing: There's no saved password for this email account. Add it in Senders & accounts.
errors.passwordUnreadable: Postloom can't read the saved password on this computer (it may have been copied from another computer). Enter the password again in Senders & accounts.
errors.secretsUnavailable: This computer can't store passwords safely right now, so the password wasn't saved.
errors.emailConnectionFailed: Postloom couldn't reach your email provider. Check your internet connection and the server details.
errors.emailSendFailed: The email couldn't be sent. Please try again later.
errors.headerLineBreak: A subject, name or email address contains a line break. Remove it and try again.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.
errors.inUse: This is still being used, so it can't be removed yet.
errors.databaseDamaged: Postloom couldn't read its saved information.
errors.databaseUpgradeFailed: Postloom couldn't update its saved information. Nothing was lost, and a backup was kept.
errors.screenTitle: Something went wrong on this screen
errors.screenBody: Your saved work is safe. Try again, and if it keeps happening, use Help → Export diagnostics.

settings.intro: Make Postloom look and behave the way you like.
settings.confirmBeforeSendHint: Shows a summary of who gets what, with 10 seconds to change your mind.

gmail.label: Gmail
gmail.appPasswordHelp: Gmail needs an app password, not your normal password. In your Google Account open Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords, create one called “Postloom” and paste the 16 letters here.

outlook.label: Outlook
outlook.appPasswordHelp: Outlook needs an app password. Sign in to your Microsoft account, open Security → Advanced security options → App passwords, create one and paste it here.

yahoo.label: Yahoo Mail
yahoo.appPasswordHelp: Yahoo needs an app password. Open Account Info → Account Security → Generate app password, choose “Other app”, name it Postloom and paste it here.

zoho.label: Zoho Mail
zoho.appPasswordHelp: Zoho needs an application-specific password. Open My Account → Security → App Passwords, generate one for Postloom and paste it here.

icloud.label: iCloud Mail
icloud.appPasswordHelp: iCloud needs an app-specific password. Sign in at account.apple.com, open Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords, create one and paste it here.

accounts.appPasswordNextBody: {{provider}} asks apps like Postloom to use a separate password instead of your normal one. We'll show you where to find it. It takes about two minutes.
accounts.otherNextBody: Your IT person or email provider can tell you the server name. Postloom only connects over an encrypted connection.
accounts.addressHint: The address people will see your emails come from.
accounts.addressInvalid: This doesn't look like an email address. Check it for typing mistakes.
accounts.passwordHint: The password for this email account.
accounts.nameHint: Only you see it, e.g. “Office Gmail”.
accounts.usernameHint: Leave empty if it's the same as your email address.
accounts.protectionKeychain: Your password is locked away in this computer's own secure keychain, never in a file. It never leaves this computer.
accounts.protectionWeak: This computer has no password keyring, so the saved password is only lightly protected. It's safer to install and unlock a keyring (such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet) before continuing.
accounts.protectionUnavailable: This computer can't store passwords safely right now, so Postloom can't save an email account. Restart your computer and try again.
accounts.testSent: Test email sent to {{address}}. Check your inbox.
accounts.removeBlocked: Used by {{count}} sender. Move or remove it first.
accounts.removeBlocked_other: Used by {{count}} senders. Move or remove them first.
accounts.fixBody: It usually means the password was changed or the app password was removed. Nothing is sent from this account until it's fixed.
accounts.fixMissingBody: Enter the password so Postloom can send from this account.

senders.title: Senders & accounts
senders.intro: An email account does the sending. A sender is who your emails appear to come from.
senders.emptyBody: A sender is the name and address people see. Connect your email first, then add a sender.
senders.noAccountsBody: Postloom sends from your own email account. Connect it and you'll be ready in a few minutes.
senders.fromNameHint: Shown as who the email is from, e.g. “Asha Kapoor”.
senders.fromNameMissing: Enter the name people will see.
senders.fromAddressHint: Usually the same as the email account's address. Some providers reject other addresses.
senders.replyToHint: Leave empty to get replies at the address above.
senders.deleteBlocked: Used by {{count}} template. Choose another sender for it first.
senders.deleteBlocked_other: Used by {{count}} templates. Choose another sender for them first.

setup.title: Set up Postloom
setup.privacy: Everything stays on this computer. Your password is locked away in your computer's own secure keychain, never in a file.
setup.welcomeBody: In a few minutes you'll connect your email, tell Postloom who you are, and send yourself a test. You can change everything later.
setup.providerBody: Postloom sends from your own email address, so replies come straight back to you.
setup.chooseFirst: Choose your email provider to continue.
setup.senderBody: This is the name people see in their inbox. You can add more senders later, for example one for each team.
setup.testBody: We'll send a short email to {{address}} so you can see it arrive.
setup.testSentBody: It can take a minute to arrive. If you can't see it, look in your spam folder.
setup.doneBody: {{account}} is connected, and your emails will come from {{sender}}.
